blocks.text: Strasbourg's cathedral is enormous and made of a warm pink sandstone that glows at sunset - I climbed the platform partway up the spire and could see all the way to the Black Forest on the German side.

The half-timbered houses in the Petite France district look like something from a storybook, with canals running between them instead of streets. Definitely the most fairytale city I've visited so far.
